pages.title: Coverage
pages.text: All 19 authored deep realms have layered trials, at least one spawnable named Boss and non-empty loot. Tickets and travel fees reserve exact ItemStack NBT and refund on failure.

pages.title: Session Ownership
pages.text: Entry creates a UUID session. Trials, bosses and reward chests bind owner/session/encounter; other players and their servitors cannot steal damage. Kills atomically claim the encounter before rewards, bestiary and quest hooks. Escrow chests expose no vanilla hopper inventory.

pages.title: Entry Rules
pages.text: Clients and normal commands cannot bypass bound gates. Dedicated-dimension failures do not degrade. Returns are free. Offline sessions expire on a shared clock; death may eject while completion evidence persists.
